brief:
Islamic Jihad movement official Ismail al-Sandawi told Shehab Wire that appointments announced in Kuwait for the Palestinian National Council elections lack basic electoral standards, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Sandawi described the process as "a farce and appointments," characterizing it as the beginning of arrangements for a post-Abbas phase. He emphasized that the selections failed to meet minimum democratic requirements expected in electoral processes.

The Palestinian National Council appointments, unveiled in Kuwait, have drawn sharp criticism from the resistance faction. Al-Sandawi's statement reflects broader opposition within Islamic Jihad to the council appointment method. The movement views the process as fundamentally flawed in its electoral legitimacy and sees it connected to broader Palestinian political transitions following the leadership of Mahmoud Abbas.
